properties.name: A0005/14 / OLBB
properties.originalText:
NAVAL SHIPS OF THE UNIFIL MARITIME TASK FORCE (MTF) ARE OPERATING
UNDER UN SECURITY COUNCIL RESOLUTION 1701 (2006) IN THE AREA
 DELINEATED BY THE AREA OUT OF 12 MILES FROM THE LEBANESE COAST
 LINE, AND BY THE COORDINATES:
-343800N 0355800E
-343800N 0350000E
-330600N 0341500E
-330600N 0350600E
ALL VFR FLIGHTS MUST AVOID OVERFLYING IN A RADIUS OF 3NM WHEN
 THEIR ALTITUDE IS LESS THAN 4000FT AROUND A UNIFIL NAVAL VESSEL
 IN THESE MENTIONED AREA ABOVE, EXCEPT COMMERCIAL FLIGHT WHEN
 THEY ARE SUBJECT TO ATC CLEARANCE FOR AVOIDING BAD WEATHER OR
 HOLDING PROCEDURES. AIRCRAFT INTRUDING WITHIN THIS AIRSPACE
 WOULD CONSTITUTE A SECURITY RISK AND HENCE MAY BE ENGAGED BY THE
SHIP'S AIR DEFENCE SYSTEM.
properties.source: FAA NMS — PRODUCTION / 本番環境

properties.name: A0290/26 / OLBB
properties.originalText:
AIRCRAFT FLYING BEIRUT FIR SHALL BE AWARE OF POSSIBLE LOSS
 OF GPS/GNSS SIGNAL,AND DUE TO CURRENT SECURITY REASONS
 PREVAILED IN THE MEDITERRANEAN AREA,THERE HAS BEEN AN INCREASE
 IN JAMMING AND/OR SPOOFING OF GLOBAL NAVIGATION SATTELITE 
 SYSTEMS (GNSS). 
LEB ANS SET IN PLACE, CONTINGENCY PLAN ,INCLUDING PROCEDURES TO
 BE FOLLOWED IN CASE OF LARGE-SCALE GNSS JAMMING AND/OR SPOOFING
 EVENTS BASED ON: 
-CONVENTIONAL ATS ROUTES,STARS AND APPROACH PROCEDURES (REF  
 TO GROUND NAVAIDS) ARE CURRENTLY HIGHLY RECOMMENDED.
-RNAV(GNSS) STARS AND RNP APPROACH PROCEDURES STILL POSSIBLE TO
 BE FOLLOWED IF PILOT REQUESTED AND UNDER HIS OWN DISCRETION.
properties.source: FAA NMS — PRODUCTION / 本番環境
